notes:
Lead inbound from demo on DevTool newsletter. CEO: 'We need a solution that can ingest ~200k tokens of repo context and keep API costs predictable for freemium -> paid users.'

Key pain: current provider price variability and limited long-context support. Primary asks: first-class Node + Python SDK with streaming + reconnect/resume, example VSCode extension integration, support for long context (200k+), clear rate-limit tiers and burst allowances, and lightweight cost controls (token estimates per call).

POC plan: 2-week trial using hosted API, 1 sample public repo (100k-200k tokens) for embeddings + retrieval + code chat. Wants sample billing estimate for 100k monthly active users with 5-10 requests/day (highly hypothetical).

Security: SMB so SOC2 and audit logs sufficient for now; public cloud ok. No strict residency needs.

Quotes/notes from eng lead: 'If we can get streaming SDK + stable 200k window we can replace our existing multi-provider setup.'

Action items: AE to provision trial keys and send SDK usage snippets; SE to prepare POC checklist and recommend batching/prefix caching settings; follow-up call to be scheduled week of 2026-02-22.
